title: Microsoft-Decision-1 targets fast routing and classification
friendlyTitle: Microsoft launches a fast AI model for making clear choices
summary: Microsoft introduced Microsoft-Decision-1, a model built for structured tasks such as routing, classification, prioritisation and verification. Microsoft says it led its 36-benchmark comparison and ran 2.5 times faster than the next-fastest model tested; it is available through Microsoft Foundry and OpenRouter.
friendlySummary: Microsoft-Decision-1 is designed to sort, rank, route and check information quickly. Microsoft says it was the fastest and most accurate model in the company’s own test.
whyItMatters: Many agent steps need a quick, bounded choice rather than a long generated answer. A specialised decision model can reduce delay and cost, although teams should test Microsoft’s benchmark claims on their own data before using it to control important workflows.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Some jobs need a simple choice, not a long AI answer. A smaller specialist model may make these jobs faster and cheaper, but businesses should test it with their own work first.
